say: Which drawings are late? Who's overloaded? Is site on the latest set?
DrawingOps answers all three, for architecture and MEP firms.
Owners see every project on one page, and every number opens its list.
Every sheet lives in one register, from planned to issued.
Import Excel lists, drop in PDFs, or sync from Revit and AutoCAD.
Designers submit with a checklist. Leads review, with senior QC built in.
One click issues a numbered transmittal, and supersedes older revisions.
Clients acknowledge from a secure link, and site only sees the current set.
Every hand-off notifies the next person, and every email is tracked.
Approved stages signal Accounts, ready to invoice.
Plus workload, site RFIs, reports, advisory forecasts and a full audit trail.
Eight roles, one live record. DrawingOps, by LatentIQ.
